title: bench.json — comparison tables transcribed from the article; only published cells, never zero-filled

hero.description: the product being covered; its row is highlighted and deltas are computed against the best other row

name.description: as printed in the article, plus a short Chinese gloss, e.g. OSWorld 2.0 · 电脑操作

alias.description: 人话别名 used in narration on first mention, e.g. 电脑操作考试

note.description: the article's footnote about competitor scores; shown under the table

flag.description: e.g. * when the note applies to this row
